idea-plugin.name: AI Usage Trackers
idea-plugin.description: Track locally recorded AI token usage with persistent history and configurable status-bar trackers. Includes Codex logs, Claude assistant logs and supported Antigravity capture files. Choose calendar periods, elapsed durations or supported provider reset-aligned weeks. Shows recorded request usage and quota percentages/reset times where available. Reads local logs and capture files without model calls or telemetry; coverage depends on the source.
